verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted AI app builder like Floot, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Floot users. The only tracking-related item is built-in visitor analytics that Floot provides for the apps users build. That is a different feature, not a privacy control over Floot's own data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
